rootCause: The terminal reservation primitive existed without a canonical broker reconciliation caller. Consequently a verified canceled remainder was never transferred through the same order/fill persistence transaction. The first runtime-capital checkpoint also retained an unnecessary timezone-dependent Date fallback and stale source-bound receipts.
implemented: Canonical matched broker orders carry their complete GET-only response into the existing reconciliation store. Complete broker-read receipt time is captured separately from the cycle start and persisted in immutable reconciliation evidence.

On schema 071, reconciliation locks the physical account before order/claim rows, matching the allocator lock order. It records broker orders and immutable fills, then invokes reconcileTerminalInTransaction on the SAME checked-out client. No extra pool, nested acquisition, provider await, independent capital commit or broker mutation occurs.

A qualified terminal simple opening order releases only canceled/rejected/expired unfilled units. Cumulative fills must equal the immutable ledger. Fully filled obligations remain reserved. Exact physical account, client/order identity, contract, side, position intent, quantity and receipt time must agree.

Pending cancellation, ambiguous responses, replacement uncertainty and native package parents retain capital. A native parent quantity cannot prove leg-level risk clearance. Unsupported or conflicting evidence persists a typed capital quarantine without discarding otherwise valid management observations.

Only enumerated capital refusals are handled through a savepoint. Unknown/database failures propagate and roll back the transaction. Resolved capital incidents retain their history and are marked resolved only after successful ledger verification.

Reconciliation returns the actual unresolved account-scoped capital incident count. The runtime account observation producer refuses new entry allocation while that count is nonzero. Broker data quality and management monitoring are not mislabeled as strategy WAIT or blanket-disabled.

Management now accepts only strict SQL DATE text. Untyped driver Date values remain explicitly unqualified instead of consulting host calendar APIs. Production SQL already casts expiration_date to text. The previous legacy-Date compatibility claim is superseded by this stricter boundary.

Immediate handoff and dedicated execution-lane tests now trace the observed enqueue adapter through the SAME canonical store. They still assert ordering, the dedicated pool and the sole handoff authority.

Phase-2/3/4 source-bound receipts were regenerated through their canonical executed-test tools, not by replacing hashes manually. These prove reviewed source behavior only, not current-worker or profitability maturity.
